_comment: HANDS-OFF DECK: for when he says 'do all of this without me': no questions, no feedback rounds, no understanding / design / before-build decks. His instruction is the go-ahead. You explore, follow the design guide, build, run the code review, the grader and the done gate, then bring THIS ONE deck, at stage 'after', at the very end.

"hands_off" is his exact words (copy them, do not tidy them); the first page quotes them. The builder refuses: a stage other than after; any understanding / design / before page; no 'What you asked for' list on the first page; no 'Choices I made for you' list; missing 'What changed while building'; missing 'Found in review' once the code review ran.

'Choices I made for you' = every decision he would normally have made in the stages he skipped: layout, where things sit, defaults, phone layout, wording. One row each. A row about something he SEES sets "visual": true and carries a "picture" (and "before" when it changed). Truly none: ONE row with "none_made": true and a plain sentence.

The done gate: `review-cards.py walkthrough-check <this file>.json` passes only when he submitted, ticked or commented on every row, every check has a result and he changed nothing. A comment on a row means another round: rebuild THIS same deck as usual (reopened / resolved).
